episode_title: Trump Eases Russia Sanctions, Midterm Campaign Money, Violent Protests In France
script_en: Trump Eases Russia Sanctions, Midterm Campaign Money, Violent Protests In France.

President Trump is easing pressure on Russia by waiving new sanctions as Ukraine continues striking Russian energy targets and tensions deepen between Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Democratic candidates are outraising Republicans across many competitive midterm races, while Elon Musk pours hundreds of millions into GOP super PACs.

France is facing one of its biggest political crises in years after nationwide protests erupted into violence, with thousands arrested and the unrest already shaping a presidential election six months away.
